title: Harness self-check: save via the Save tab, copy out, wipe, seed, load through the title
_comment: NOT a protocol segment. Acceptance evidence for ralph/GATE_F_INSTRUMENTATION_REQUEST.md item 4 and section 7: the whole handoff, driven end to end through production paths and synthetic physical input, with no game code change. Slot 4 is the handoff slot (autosave is 0; 1-3 stay free for natural play coverage).
_comment_why_a_walk_first: The player is moved somewhere distinctive before saving on purpose. A save taken at the spawn point round-trips to a position a FRESH boot would also produce, so the load would prove nothing.

steps.title: boot the real Meadows
steps.expected: the real world scene stands up with the real autoloads

steps.title: let the opening fade finish
steps.expected: the boot fade completes and the interaction arbiter comes back; until it does, input_context reads 'locked'

steps.title: DIAG: stand somewhere a fresh boot never puts the player
steps.expected: the player stands at The Pond, 600 m up the corridor. A DIAG jump rather than a walk on purpose: this segment's subject is the save round trip, and the spawn point sits in Grandpa's dooryard where a walk spends its whole budget squeezing past the house. A save taken AT the spawn would round-trip to a position a fresh boot also produces, so the load would prove nothing -- the distinctive position is the entire point, and how the player got there is not.

steps.title: record where the save is being taken from

args.text: the position in this event's `pos` is what the load has to bring back

steps.expected: a note event carrying the pre-save position

steps.title: open the pause shell
steps.expected: the game_menu button opens the shell onto the Satchel tab

steps.title: cycle right to the Save tab
steps.expected: five RB presses move from the Satchel tab to Save, the sixth tab in data/config/menu.json. One step with times:5 rather than five identical steps -- with a line per press there is no way to see which one did not land.

steps.title: the Save tab is up
steps.expected: input_context names the live tab: menu_save

steps.title: move focus down to slot 4's Save button
steps.expected: focus starts on slot 0's Save button (tab_save.gd::first_focus) and four d-pad downs reach slot 4's

steps.title: press Save
steps.expected: the focused Save button activates and writes slot 4

steps.title: give the write a moment
steps.expected: the slot file is on disk

steps.title: copy the slot out of user://
steps.expected: the file the Save tab just wrote is preserved in the run directory

steps.title: close the shell
steps.expected: B closes the shell

steps.title: wipe the live save directory
steps.expected: every slot file is gone; a load that found the state still in memory would prove nothing

steps.title: seed the wiped directory from the copy
steps.expected: slot 4 exists again, from the run directory rather than from anything still in memory

steps.title: boot the real title screen
steps.expected: the world is torn down and the real title comes up with Start New Game focused

steps.title: the title owns input
steps.expected: the title focuses its first button; without focus a controller cannot start the game at all

steps.title: move focus to Load Game
steps.expected: d-pad down moves focus from Start New Game to Load Game

steps.title: open the load slot list
steps.expected: Load Game opens the slot list and auto-focuses the first non-empty slot -- which is the seeded slot 4

steps.title: load the seeded slot
steps.expected: the slot loads and the title transitions into the Meadows

steps.title: let the loaded pose land
steps.expected: the world stands up from the title's Load and Game.apply_loaded_player_pose() runs. 180 s because a cold Meadows stand-up costs about 90 s of CPU on this container -- 466k scattered props and a terrain build -- and the assertions below read a live Player.

steps.title: the player came back where the save was taken
steps.expected: the loaded position is the saved one, 600 m up the corridor, not the fresh-boot spawn in the village

steps.title: the party came back
steps.expected: the party matches the save. On this fresh-game round trip that is zero -- the segment proves the party TRAVELS, not that a populated one does; a populated round trip is smoke_save_persistence.gd's job.

steps.title: the region containment agrees
steps.expected: map_state.gd's own containment puts the loaded position in The Pond -- a region a fresh boot could not be standing in

steps.title: close the segment

args.text: save handoff round trip complete: Save tab -> copy out -> wipe -> seed -> title Load. No game code was called directly at any point.

steps.expected: a note event closes the segment
